title: Chapter 353 - 353 Accompany; Acquire A Hotel!
content:
Chapter 353 - 353 Accompany; Acquire A Hotel!

Chapter 353 - 353 Accompany; Acquire a Hotel!

353 Accompany; Acquire a Hotel!

Earlier, Xue Baoguo saw that President Liu was trying his best to please Young Master Wu.

As for Young Master Wu… When he was treating Lin Fan with the utmost respect, Xue Baoguo was a little puzzled.

Now, even the chairman of Qing Kun Group was so polite to Lin Fan.

One had to know…

Qing Kun Group was the largest company in Qing City, and it had a wide range of businesses, including supermarkets, hotels, daily necessities, real estate, clothing, and so on.

In fact, because of Lin Fan’s words, the chairman of Qing Kun Group even shook his hand and let him become the main vendor of the company’s pork and beef?

This… This…

Was Lin Fan not from an ordinary family?

Lin Fan’s learning ability was very strong, but he only graduated less than two years ago, right?

This… How could Young Master Wu and the chairman of Qing Kun Group treat him like this?

This…

What was going on?

Could it be that he had not woken up yet?

Naturally, Lin Fan did not know what Xue Baoguo was thinking. He was already attracted by a sentence that suddenly sounded in his mind.

[Ding! You’ve completed a hidden mission—a drop of water will be repaid with a spring. You have received one golden packet.]

‘A drop of water will be repaid with a spring?’

Was this… Was it about helping Uncle Xue?

One golden packet?

This was a pleasant surprise.

In reality, Lin Fan was not wrong.

This was indeed the reward for helping Xue Baoguo.

Now, Lin Fan had first cured Xue Baoguo.

Then, he helped him get one million yuan.

Finally, he also got him to be Qing Kun Group’s pork and beef supplier…

If this was not repaying a drop of water with a spring, then what was?

At this moment, Li Wannian said, “It’s almost time for dinner. Qing Kun Hotel is just ahead. Mr. Lin, Mr. Xue… and Lil Wu, why don’t we go for a meal together?”

Lin Fan nodded. “Sure.”

Wu Kai had always wanted to interact more with Lin Fan. Naturally, he would not disagree.

Xue Baoguo, who was still in a daze, followed behind them.

When the waiters of Qing Kun Hotel saw Li Wannian, they greeted him respectfully, “Hello, Chairman Li.”

After a wave of greetings, Lin Fan, Li Wannian, Wu Kai, and Xue Baoguo arrived at a luxurious private room.

Immediately after, dishes of delicious food, high-end white wine, and so on were served.

Li Wannian personally poured a glass of wine for everyone and then toasted with them.

After drinking this glass of wine, the rich spiciness stimulated Xue Baoguo’s throat, making him realize… that all of this was not a dream.

It was all true!

…

After Lin Fan left Qing Kun Hotel, he went home and stayed with his parents for a while before driving toward Jiangbei.

Although he felt that it was fine to stay at home for a few more days, his parents didn’t think so. They felt that school was the most important thing.

When the sky gradually darkened, Lin Fan had already returned to the Coiling Dragon Villa.

He sat on the soft sofa and played with his phone.

When he opened his WeChat Moments, he saw that Chu Yunyue had just forwarded a company article.

Instantly, Lin Fan could not help but recall Chu Yunyue’s pretty and serious face.

Hence, he opened her chat box and sent her a message.

Lin Fan: [You haven’t slept yet?]

Chu Yunyue seemed to be using her phone. She replied almost instantly.

Chu Yunyue: [Yeah, I’ve been working overtime to process the information for the International Perfume Exhibition in Eagle Country. I’ve only just returned home.]

Lin Fan could almost imagine Chu Yunyue’s tired face.

Hence, he sent out a message.

Lin Fan: [You can hand it over to your subordinates. You don’t have to tire yourself out.]

Chu Yunyue replied: [I’ve already passed on many things. But this exhibition is very important. I have to go and be there personally. So, I have to prepare some things myself.]

Lin Fan: [You’re going to Eagle Country personally? When?]

Chu Yunyue replied: [The exhibition is on Thursday. I’m going there tomorrow.]

Lin Fan said: [Then I’ll go with you.]

Chu Yunyue: [Really?]

Lin Fan replied: [Of course. Have a good rest tonight. I’ll pick you up tomorrow morning.]

Chu Yunyue replied: [Okay!]

The reason why Lin Fan decided to go to Eagle Country with Chu Yunyue was that he was worried.

Firstly, it had been a long time since he last accompanied her.

Secondly, he had never left the country.

Taking this opportunity to go overseas to take a look seemed like a good idea.

After ending his conversation with Chu Yunyue, Lin Fan focused his attention on… the golden packet that he received today.

“One golden packet. Let’s see what I can get,” Lin Fan muttered to himself.

“Open!”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received Sun Simiao’s Medical Experience.]

Seeing this…

Lin Fan was stunned.

Sun Simiao?

Was he not the famous godly doctor and king pharmacist in history?

His experience?

Just as Lin Fan was in a daze, in his mind…Suddenly, countless complex and profound medical knowledge emerged.

After a while, Lin Fan opened his eyes and muttered, “I already have such superb medical skills?”

That night, Lin Fan was sleeping soundly.

When Lin Fan opened his eyes, the sky was already bright.

He looked at his phone and saw a message.

[Notice from Merchant Bank: 7,589,020 yuan was deposited into your account.]

“Sign in!”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained Royal Hotel in Eagle Country.]

Seeing this…

Lin Fan’s face revealed a strange expression. He was just about to head to Eagle Country and he obtained a hotel in Eagle Country?

“Lil White, do you know about Royal Hotel in Eagle Country?” asked Lin Fan.

“The Royal Hotel in Eagle Country was built in 2002. It took eight years to build and cost three billion Eagle Dollars. Due to its tall and luxurious appearance, it became one of the iconic buildings of Eagle Country,” Lil White said in a very clear voice.

When Lin Fan heard this, the weird expression on his face grew even more intense.

This hotel was actually in Eagle Country. Was this not too much of a coincidence?

At this moment, the phone in his pocket rang.

He looked at the caller ID and saw that it was an unknown number from overseas.

If it were an ordinary person, they would have been shocked to see an unfamiliar foreign phone call.

Their first reaction was to hang up.

However, Lin Fan had already received many foreign calls.

Therefore, he did not hang up. Instead, he pressed the answer button.

“Hello, is this Mr. Lin?” A very gentle and respectful voice came from the phone.

Lin Fan said, “It’s me. You are?”

“Hello, Mr. Lin. I’m Jack Smith, the chairman of Eagle Country’s Royal Hotel. I hope I didn’t disturb your rest?” The voice on the phone became more respectful.

Lin Fan said, “No, I’m already up.”

Jack Smith heaved a sigh of relief. “That’s really great…”
